summary: MSFS 2020 and 2024 tracking works in the desktop app.
releaseNotes: MSFS 2020 and 2024 are tracked again: the desktop app now ships the SimConnect connector it needs, which earlier builds left out.
The bridge no longer tells desktop users to run pip install SimConnect; the connector comes with the app.
